about: The one row-kind classification (CONTEXT.md "row kind"): what a scene inventory row's objects do in their scene, worked out free from the reading's own words, never from a model call or a record per scene (score/stages/row_kinds.py). A row's kind is the first kind, in this file's order, whose `nouns` hold its reading noun whole (the reading's head noun, the row's `noun`: a "floor plate" is no plate); only a row read with no noun is matched by its name's last word. A row whose noun no kind holds is a kind's when its name ends in one of the kind's `held_by` words after one of its nouns (a "floodlight tower" read as a tower, a "lantern string" read as a wire, a "grow light frame": lamps on what holds them; a "light switch" is none). A kind says what its objects do (`does`): emits (a particle effect of data/checks/effects.json, `effects`, made by the effects stage), moves (a rigid move of the motion stage, `motion`: its kind in data/checks/motion.json with the cited speeds, and how it moves, or why it stands), loose (free to fall and be pushed: the physics trial drops or pushes it), glows (a lamp: the light layer's), shows (a screen), grows (a plant: the crops layer's, where it stands on a bed), acts (a person: the cast's and the characters layer's), roams (an animal: its body and clips rows, score/stages/animals; `fish` names the nouns whose body is a fish, every other is four-legged; a bird has no body route yet, so no kind) and sounds (a library sound of data/sound/sounds.json, `sound`, played at each of its objects by the sound stage: one name, or one a reading noun, a noun it does not name silent). A motion rule with `needs` stands its object with `still_without` where the need is not met. The `kind` field of a row (code or generate) is how it is made, not this. A kind with `on` emits only where its row stands on (its anchor `on:<row>`) a row of one of those kinds: a pot steams on a cooker, never a bare hob or a pot on a shelf. A motion rule is chosen by the row's own words too: the first of its kind's `variants` whose `words` its name holds (a sliding door slides, a garage door rises), and one of its `open_words` stands it open. A motion rule with `needs` "passes" moves only for a walker of the scene's cast whose route comes within a metre of the object, timed off that crossing. A move no stage makes (`launch`, `cloth`, `ripple`, `split`) is a gap the motion row fails by name, never a still. `read_by` names the stage that makes what each `does` value says (null: none yet, so a row doing it is uncovered); `moving_words` are the words of a moving thing: a row whose noun holds one and whose kind neither moves, is loose, nor `stands` with a written reason is uncovered, and the motion row fails it (row_kinds.uncovered). Every entry is general: a word, never a scene's name.

motion.why: a door swings a right angle open on the hinge at its own left edge and shuts again
motion.still_without: nobody passes through it: no walker's route in the scene's cast comes within a metre of its doorway, and a door swinging open and shut with no one there read as a board sweeping across the doorway (the world 1 film diagnosis, M3, 2026-10-18); it stands as its row's words say (shut, or open where they say so)

motion.why: a sliding door slides its own width along its wall and back
a garage, roller or shutter door rises its own height and comes down again
a double door opens as two leaves from its middle, and its model is one piece: the prop pipeline gives no leaf parts to swing apart
a bridge crane travels along its runway, across its own span, as far as its kind's middle speed carries it in half a round less two seconds, and back
a robot arm slews a right angle about the upright through its own middle and back

a rocket lifts off on its exhaust: a one-off climb with its flame and smoke, and no stage makes one yet (no launch effect kind measured on footage in data/checks/effects.json, and the looping layer holds no one-off climb)
a flag or banner waves as cloth in the air: the effects overlay's Newton VBD cloth maker, which is not made yet
open water ripples and catches the light: no stage makes a water surface yet
a crane slews a right angle about its own middle and back
a fan turns steadily about its own middle
a vehicle drives along free lanes, which a plan does not hold: it stands parked where the plan lays it
a lift's travel needs the height it serves, which a plan does not hold: it stands lowered where the plan lays it

craft.stands: a craft stands parked on its pad or in its bay: a lift-off is a one-off climb the looping layer does not hold
